title: Roaming Zone A - ASEAN Countries
content:
Zone A covers all ASEAN member countries and offers the most affordable roaming rates. Countries included: Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, Vietnam, Myanmar, Cambodia, Laos, and Brunei. Without a roaming package, pay-per-use rates are: Data: PHP 15/MB. Calls (outgoing): PHP 20/minute. Calls (incoming): PHP 10/minute. Texts (outgoing): PHP 8/text. Texts (incoming): Free.

Recommended roaming packages (subscribe before departure):

- ASEAN Roam Daily (PHP 299/day): 1GB data, 30 minutes outgoing calls, unlimited incoming calls, 50 outgoing texts. Auto-renews daily. Text ROAM299 to 2123.

- ASEAN Roam Weekly (PHP 999/7 days): 5GB data, 120 minutes outgoing calls, unlimited incoming calls, 200 outgoing texts. Text ROAM999 to 2123.

- ASEAN Roam Monthly (PHP 2,499/30 days): 15GB data, unlimited outgoing calls to ASEAN and PH, unlimited incoming calls, unlimited texts. Best for extended stays. Text ROAM2499 to 2123.

To activate roaming before travel, dial *888*77# or text ROAMING ON to 2123. Prepaid users need a minimum PHP 500 balance. Your phone will automatically connect to a partner network upon arrival. Preferred networks: Telkomsel (Indonesia), Maxis (Malaysia), AIS (Thailand), Viettel (Vietnam), Singtel (Singapore).

title: Roaming Zone B - Asia-Pacific Countries
content:
Zone B covers Asia-Pacific countries outside ASEAN. Countries included: Japan, South Korea, China, Hong Kong, Taiwan, India, Australia, New Zealand, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Nepal, and Pakistan. Without a roaming package, pay-per-use rates are: Data: PHP 25/MB. Calls (outgoing): PHP 35/minute. Calls (incoming): PHP 15/minute. Texts (outgoing): PHP 12/text. Texts (incoming): Free.

Recommended roaming packages (subscribe before departure):

- APAC Roam Daily (PHP 499/day): 800MB data, 20 minutes outgoing calls, unlimited incoming calls, 30 outgoing texts. Auto-renews daily. Text ROAMAPAC499 to 2123.

- APAC Roam Weekly (PHP 1,799/7 days): 4GB data, 90 minutes outgoing calls, unlimited incoming calls, 150 outgoing texts. Text ROAMAPAC1799 to 2123.

- APAC Roam Monthly (PHP 3,999/30 days): 12GB data, 300 minutes outgoing calls to APAC and PH, unlimited incoming calls, unlimited texts. Ideal for business travelers. Text ROAMAPAC3999 to 2123.

Popular destinations: Japan (partner: NTT Docomo), South Korea (partner: SK Telecom), Australia (partner: Telstra), Hong Kong (partner: CSL), China (partner: China Mobile). Data speeds may vary by country. 4G LTE is available in most Zone B countries.

title: Roaming Zone C - Europe, USA, Middle East, Africa & Rest of World
content:
If you are going to Europe, USA, UK, Canada, Middle East, or Africa, you are in ACME Roaming Zone C (Rest of World). Zone C covers all remaining countries including the Americas, Europe, Middle East, and Africa. Key countries include: United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, and South Africa. Without a roaming package, pay-per-use rates are: Data: PHP 50/MB. Calls (outgoing): PHP 55/minute. Calls (incoming): PHP 25/minute. Texts (outgoing): PHP 15/text. Texts (incoming): Free.

Recommended roaming packages (subscribe before departure):

- World Roam Daily (PHP 799/day): 500MB data, 15 minutes outgoing calls, unlimited incoming calls, 20 outgoing texts. Auto-renews daily. Text ROAMWORLD799 to 2123.

- World Roam Weekly (PHP 2,999/7 days): 3GB data, 60 minutes outgoing calls, unlimited incoming calls, 100 outgoing texts. Text ROAMWORLD2999 to 2123.

- World Roam Monthly (PHP 5,999/30 days): 10GB data, 200 minutes outgoing calls to any country, unlimited incoming calls, unlimited texts. Best for OFWs and extended international travel. Text ROAMWORLD5999 to 2123.

Tip for OFWs: If staying in one country long-term, a local SIM with a roaming package for PH calls may be more economical. Use the ACMEIDD Sakto bundle (PHP 15/15 min) from the local SIM to call home. ACME also offers special OFW Data Packs for Middle East countries starting at PHP 399/week (2GB data + unlimited calls to PH ACME numbers). Text OFWPACK to 2123 for current offers.

Partner networks: AT&T/T-Mobile (USA), Vodafone (UK/Europe), Etisalat (UAE), STC (Saudi Arabia). Data speeds available up to 4G LTE in most countries; 3G only in some African and island nations.
